description:
pattern     bento-grid / contact
surface     dark
kit         none
form        Columns 1–5 host the heading and personal closing statement; columns 6–12 display direct contact touchpoints including interactive LinkedIn and GitHub buttons, a direct mail channel, and a prominent CV download button. On mobile, the contact links stack in a vertical list.
copy
  eyebrow      CONNECT & COLLABORATE
  heading      Let’s Build What’s Next
  closing-line Whether you have an ambitious engineering role, a groundbreaking venture, or simply want to talk systems architecture — my inbox is always open.
  btn-linkedin LinkedIn Profile
  btn-github   GitHub Repositories
  email-addr   tharindu.perera@example.com
  btn-cv       Download CV
motion      Contact cards reveal with stagger of 60ms; CV download button features an ambient pulsing border highlight.
plan check  heading placed; short closing line placed; LinkedIn button placed; GitHub button placed; email address placed; "Download CV" button placed.
layout_description: Two-column split with heading and message on the left and interactive connection buttons and CV download on the right.
